scripts.start: rm -rf .next/standalone/public .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -R public .next/standalone/public && mkdir -p .next/standalone/.next && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && node .next/standalone/server.js
scripts.gen:all: ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-routes.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-link-graph.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-spoke-data.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-page-manifests.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-faq-variants.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-local-proof-blocks.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-uniqueness.ts
scripts.gen:sitemaps: ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-sitemaps.ts && ts-node --project tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/generate-robots.ts
scripts.build:static: npm run build && npm run gen:sitemaps
